issues.claim: Phone line 866-573-0445 and email, staffed Monday-Friday 8:00AM-5:00PM EST (evidence: 'About page publishes weekday 8-5 EST hours')
issues.problem: The weekday hours are real but the cited URL (Contact-Us) shows only 'Hours: 8:00am - 5:00pm EST' with no weekday qualifier; 'Monday - Friday 8:00AM - 5:00PM EST' appears on the About Us page instead. The evidence text and the source_url point at different pages.
issues.fix: Keep the Monday-Friday wording but cite https://www.albanycountyfasteners.com/Customer-Service/About-Us/ for it, and cite Contact-Us only for the number, email and Edison address.

issues.claim: Shopware 6 storefront current_tools evidence: 'profile tech footprint records Shopware 6 with bulk pricing configured in the platform and order history in the account portal'
issues.problem: That clause cites an unnamed third-party 'profile' with no URL, so the evidence as written is unverifiable. The underlying claim is true, but it is supported by the storefront itself (Shopware theme asset paths, cms-element/sw-* markup) and the homepage's 'volume pricing applied automatically' line, not by the cited profile.
issues.fix: Replace the 'profile tech footprint' wording with the storefront HTML and homepage evidence already used elsewhere, and drop the unlinkable profile reference.

issues.claim: Baserow free plan gives reps 'a filterable queue with a status column and row-change history' and 'paid plans start at US$10 per user per month'
issues.problem: Both numbers are correct, but free-tier row change history is 14 days only, and the US$10 rate is the billed-yearly price (monthly is US$12). The plan's append-only approval log therefore cannot rest on Baserow's change history on the free plan.
issues.fix: Say 'US$10 per user/month billed yearly (US$12 monthly)' and state that the approval log is a separate append-only table written by the service, not Baserow's 14-day row history.

issues.claim: Design: 'Nothing is emailed to a customer by the agent... sent from the rep's own mailbox'; component list uses Postmark inbound + a USD 16.50/month email cost line
issues.problem: Internally consistent on price (Postmark Pro is US$16.50 and inbound processing is Pro-only, not Basic), but the running-cost line is labelled 'Inbound and outbound email' while the design routes all customer mail through the rep's own mailbox. The outbound half of that line is not actually consumed.
issues.fix: Rename the cost line 'Inbound email processing (quote mailbox)' so the cost matches the architecture.

issues.claim: Benefit range USD 13,900-41,700/year, 50-100 RFQs/week and 30 minutes per quote used throughout suggested_pricing and feasibility
issues.problem: These come from the internal audit and are not publicly verifiable from this folder; the arithmetic built on them (monthly USD 1,158-3,475; 65% / 22%; 54% / 18%) is correct, and the plan itself flags the inputs as unmeasured assumptions.
issues.fix: No change required before use; keep the assumptions labelled as they are and let the week-one timed baseline replace them, as the plan already proposes.
